mapper.select: select IFNULL(available_amount, 0) as availableAmount, IFNULL(frozen_amount, 0) as frozenAmount, IFNULL(settled_amount, 0) as settledAmount from sys_income_account where user_id = #{userId}

select IFNULL(total_income, 0) as totalIncome, IFNULL(month_income, 0) as monthIncome, IFNULL(total_orders, 0) as totalOrders, IFNULL(sold_count, 0) as soldCount from sys_creator_stats where user_id = #{userId} order by stat_date desc limit 1

select o.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.total_amount as amount, w.title as workTitle, o.status as status from sys_order o left join sys_work w on o.work_id = w.work_id where o.seller_id = #{userId} and o.status = 'completed' and o.order_id not in ( select order_id from sys_invoice where order_id is not null and status <> 'rejected' ) order by o.complete_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_income_account (user_id, available_amount, frozen_amount, settled_amount, version, created_at, updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{amount}, 0, #{amount}, 0, now(), now()) on duplicate key update available_amount = available_amount + #{amount}, settled_amount = settled_amount + #{amount}, updated_at = now()

insert into sys_bill_record (bill_no, user_id, bill_type, amount, balance_after, related_type, related_id, remark, create_time) values (#{billNo}, #{userId}, #{billType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, #{remark}, now())

insert into sys_creator_stats (user_id, total_income, month_income, total_orders, published_count, reviewing_count, sold_count, total_views, total_favorites, avg_rating, stat_date) values (#{userId}, #{amount}, #{amount}, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0.0, CURDATE()) on duplicate key update total_income = total_income + #{amount}, month_income = month_income + #{amount}, total_orders = total_orders + 1, sold_count = sold_count + 1
